name: excalidraw
description: Connect Excalidraw to Fractal through its MCP server and access the operations exposed to the connected account.

interface.shortDescription: Use Excalidraw MCP tools from your Fractal workspace.
interface.longDescription: Connect Excalidraw to your Fractal workspace so your agent can work with hand-drawn diagrams using the tools exposed by the service. Available actions depend on the live MCP server and the connected account’s permissions.
defaultPrompt: Give me an overview of my Excalidraw workspace.
Find anything in Excalidraw that needs attention and explain why.
Help me review hand-drawn diagrams in Excalidraw.
